newsitem.title: GERMANY: German trade seeks free mkt wheat, barley exports.
newsitem.headline: German trade seeks free mkt wheat, barley exports.

text.p: German traders made bids to export 19,000 tonnes of free market soft wheat with rebates in a range between 14.59 and 21.50 Ecus a tonne, state grain intervention board BLE said on Thursday.
BLE also received bids for the export of 5,000 tonnes of free market barley, where the desired restitutions were in a 28.69-29.99 Ecus/tonne range.
BLE received no bids for free market rye exports.
